title: The Companion of Tempered Resolve
summary: A companion for the will-aligned past the courses that forges resolve like iron and strikes with the anvil of it.

title: Treatise of the Willed Field
summary: A treatise on spreading the will round the body as a field that presses on foes and steadies friends inside it.

title: Canon of Spoken Decrees
summary: A canon of decrees spoken with the full field of will behind them that bind the foe and call back the nearly dead.

title: Treatise of the Azure Vow
summary: A treatise on the vow sworn under the open blue of the sky and kept with a clear unclouded will.

title: Manual of the Unbent Brow
summary: A manual of the head that never bows and the will that returns each pressure to the one who laid it.

title: Canon of the Lofty Intent
summary: A canon of an intent held high and clear that sees the whole field below and draws a failing breath back to the body.

title: The Wind-Sworn Will Manual
summary: A manual of a will sworn to the wind that bends under no push and answers each gust with a harder one.

title: Manual of the Open Command
summary: A manual of the command given plainly and openly that needs no cover and breaks the bonds laid on a friend's mind.

title: Treatise on the Unspoken Verdict
summary: A treatise on the verdict reached in silence and carried out with a will that needs no word to land.
